issues.title: Not providing `CHANNEL_CUSTOM` channels
issues.body:
In the last 6 months we've gone through a change in how channels are created by the Game Designer, and how they are provided to players.

Currently, `factory.tsx` does not provide `CHANNEL_CUSTOM` channels to players:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/157206173-5e49b926-5876-4dac-802d-51b15fe6b9a8.png)

We should handle `CHANNEL_CUSTOM` and give them what was the normal channel style - with the message selector at the bottom.

Note: I have just looked for the component to use for the Custom style of channel - but couldn't find it.
